description:
Before you ask, yes, this release is **uncut and uncensored**. Video is ripped from ComicFestaアニメZone. Episodes there cost ￥300 each, so you're welcome. This site streams every Sunday at 11:00am EST (UTC-5), so expect episodes by Sunday evening. 

This is a solo release, so you get a better TL than this show deserves and nice, juicy encodes, but no typesetting. Deal with it. 

Also, please report any issues you do find here. I will check the comments. 

Enjoy!

From the official website (spoilers, I guess...):

#1 An Unexpected Reunion (R-18)

This 25 year old will go to school pretending to be her truant younger cousin! While she can handle going to class, she has trouble following all the showy pretenses of high school life and ends up in a tough spot, forcing her to take refuge in the nurse's office when all of a sudden Kanie, a teacher, greets her by saying, "Aren't you Hana Natori?", which totally blows her cover. In a surprising turn of events, it turns out that Kanie was a former classmate of hers back in high school! Moreover, without any warning he asks her, "do you know what to do to keep a man quiet?" and starts kissing her deeply, pushing her down in the process! With secrets piling up on one another, there's no running away!

description:
![alt text](https://s6.postimg.cc/qlyrr6iv5/SWAN.png)

**Title**: Hara ☆ Para!! ~Swan Nakadashi Paradise~
**Original title**: 孕ら☆パラっ!!～スワン中出しパラダイス～
**Length**: Short (2 - 10 hours)
**Year**: Japan 2011-04-22, English Patch 2015-05-30
**Developer**: Swanmania
**Publishers**: Swanmania
**Language**: English
**Voice**: Japanese
**Translation**: [Loe Quality Translations](http://loequality.blogspot.bg/2015/05/still-around-and-working-on-backlog.html)

**Description**:

In this fandisk, the protagonist end up prisoner of Swan worlds.
To escape, he will have to impregnate women from various games.
They will naturally accept him, for it his how fate is written.

**Important**:

1. You need to change system locale to Japanese.

2. Start the game with harapara.exe

3. About the patch:
 - Partial Main Menu translation in English and "subtitles" for the Configuration Settings is included .(The Main Menu have two versions. It is random. One of them is not translated. Just restart the game and if you're lucky the translated version will appear.)
 - Yuka’s two h-scenes will be in Japanese.
